name: smartypants
description: Keeps a Mermaid-style system diagram and a compact memory of your architectural intent while an agent codes, goes deeper on any part on request, and flags where the code drifts from the intent.

interface.shortDescription: Diagram the system while an agent codes.
interface.longDescription: Smartypants watches a coding agent, draws the system at system, component, and module depth in a Mermaid-style canvas, keeps the user's intent as compact IntentCode, goes deeper on request, and flags code that leaves the intent.
defaultPrompt: Turn on Smartypants for this project and open the system diagram.
Go deeper on the most important component.
